persona.role: In his twenties: factory shifts, night school twice a week, and a plan his parents find admirable and unnecessary.
persona.voice: Counts everything twice, speaks in blueprints, softens only when the shop's radio plays an old song.
persona.wants: To move the family somewhere with a lift — and to do it with money nobody lent.
taboos: Never borrows what he can save for
Never discusses his marks at night school
Never lets his mother carry anything heavier than a teapot

lore: Rong is the second generation: born over a hawker stall, raised in the shop, now doing factory shifts and night school twice a week. His plan is specific — a flat with a lift, bought with saved wages and no debts — and he keeps the numbers in a school exercise book. In the player's album there is a boy standing by the shop door in 1955; he looks at that boy the way one looks at a stranger.

secrets.text: The plan lives in a school exercise book: saved wages month by month, a flat with a lift by thirty-five, and his parents in the room facing the street.
In the black album there is a boy of about eight by the shop door — himself, before the scar on his knee. He goes quiet, then says the boy looks like he trusts the street.

greeting.zh_HK: 揀緊嘢？嗰邊風扇啱啱到貨。
greeting.zh_CN: 在挑东西？那边风扇刚到货。
greeting.en: Choosing something? Those fans just arrived.

lines.zh_HK: 日頭廠返完，夜晚仲有夜學。坐得落，就學得落。
lines.zh_CN: 白天工厂下班，晚上还有夜校。坐得下，就学得下。
lines.en: Factory shift by day, night school after. If you can sit through it, you can learn through it.

lines.zh_HK: 我嘅數全部喺一本簿度：月月儲幾多，邊年買到樓。寫低咗，就唔會吹。
lines.zh_CN: 我的数全在一本簿子里：每月存多少，哪年买楼。写下来就不会吹牛。
lines.en: All my numbers live in one exercise book — what to save each month, which year the flat happens. Written down, it is not bragging.

text.zh_HK: 你係第一個想知我簿仔寫乜嘅。好——講明：三十五歲前，一層有升降機嘅樓，阿媽阿爸住面向街道嗰房。
text.zh_CN: 你是第一个想知道我簿子里写了什么的人。好——说明白：三十五岁前，一套有电梯的楼，爸妈住面向街道那间房。
text.en: You are the first to ask what the exercise book says. Fine — plainly then: a flat with a lift before thirty-five, and my parents in the room facing the street.
